clue.text: Getting bent cons incarcerated, served with panels

indicators.note: incarcerated means locked up inside, so the rearranged letters go inside the other word

parts.note: to serve at table is to wait, so served gives waited

indicators.note: getting bent means being twisted out of shape, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Crooked convicts locked up and served time in a wood-panelled jail.
explanation.walkthrough: 'served' looks like part of the definition but is the outer piece; 'Getting bent' scrambles the convicts and 'incarcerated' locks them in.
explanation.definitionFit: Wainscot is wooden panelling on a lower wall, so a wainscoted room is fitted with panels.

clue.text: Nonconformist writhing in a clay-pit

indicators.note: writhing means twisting about, so the letters of these words are rearranged

explanation.surface: A dissenter is squirming at the bottom of a clay pit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'writhing' rearranges the eight letters of A CLAY-PIT.
explanation.definitionFit: Something atypical departs from the usual type, as a nonconformist departs from the norm.

clue.text: Cut flower showing love

indicators.note: cut here means docked of its last letter, so the river's final letter goes

parts.note: a flower is something that flows, a river, here the Nile

explanation.surface: A cut bloom being displayed as a token of affection.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flower' is a crossword favourite for a river (a thing that flows); 'Cut' removes the last E of NILE.
explanation.definitionFit: Love is a tennis score of zero, the same as nothing.

clue.text: Persistently preserve the general rule?

parts.note: to preserve food is to can it
on, as in carry on or keep on, means persistently

explanation.surface: A question whether to keep the general rule going for good.
explanation.definitionFit: A canon is an accepted principle or law by which things are judged.

clue.text: Having completed medical degree, I'll show clots

parts.note: thro, a short spelling of through, means finished or done with
MB is Bachelor of Medicine, a medical degree
the I of the clue, with 'll (will) joining it to show

explanation.surface: A newly qualified doctor promises to demonstrate blood clots.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Having completed' is THRO, as in 'I'm through with it'.
explanation.definitionFit: Thrombi are blood clots that form inside a vessel; the word is the plural of thrombus.

clue.text: Positive images succeeded about time

indicators.note: about here means going round, so the first pieces surround the next one

parts.note: doubles are exact likenesses or images of someone
S is the standard abbreviation for succeeded in genealogies

explanation.surface: Photos that were successful a while ago look upbeat.
explanation.walkthrough: The dash in the clue hides that 'about' wraps the images and the succession round the time abbreviation.
explanation.definitionFit: Being doubtless means being sure, which is what positive means in 'I'm positive'.

clue.text: Slip worn to keep hands warm

definitions.meaning: to slip is to fumble or bungle, as a fielder does a catch
a tube of fur into which both hands are pushed for warmth

explanation.definitionFit: To muff is to bungle a catch, and a muff is also a fur hand-warmer.

clue.text: Churn out shoddy damp courses

indicators.note: shoddy means badly made, so the letters of these words are reworked

explanation.surface: Badly made damp-proof layers are being turned out in bulk.
explanation.walkthrough: A damp course is a waterproof layer laid in a wall; 'shoddy' rearranges its letters.
explanation.definitionFit: To churn out is to produce in large quantities, as a factory does with mass production.

clue.text: It's fine to admit being inactive

parts.note: F is the pencil-grade abbreviation for fine
to allow is to admit or let in

explanation.surface: Someone says it is all right to confess to idleness.
explanation.definitionFit: Fallow land is left unplanted for a season, so it is resting and inactive.

clue.text: Some makeup used by a looker?

definitions.text: Some makeup used by a looker?

parts.words: Some makeup used by a looker?
parts.note: a looker seems to be a beautiful person, but read literally it is the eye, and this cosmetic lines it

explanation.surface: A question about which cosmetics a beautiful woman uses.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a cosmetic drawn along the lid, so it is makeup applied around the organ of sight.

clue.text: Girl runs into usual suspect

indicators.note: into says one piece is placed inside the other
suspect as an adjective means doubtful or dodgy, so the letters of usual are rearranged

parts.note: R is the cricket scoring abbreviation for runs

explanation.surface: A girl dashes in among the usual suspects in a police line-up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'suspect' turns USUAL into USULA; 'into' puts R inside it after the first U. 'usual suspect' echoes the film phrase.
explanation.definitionFit: Ursula is a woman's given name, so a girl's name.

clue.text: Star inhaling nine grams that's handy during shooting

indicators.note: inhaling means taking in, so the star takes the other letters inside

parts.note: the sun is a star
IX is nine in Roman numerals
G is the abbreviation for grams

explanation.surface: A film star sniffing cocaine is useful on a shoot.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests a celebrity and drugs on a film set; the shooting is with a revolver.
explanation.definitionFit: A six-gun is a revolver holding six rounds, an obvious tool when shooting.

clue.text: Players smear this on to relieve soreness coming in right after start of game

indicators.note: after says the rest follows the letter just taken
the start of a word is its first letter
coming in means entering, so these pieces go inside the abbreviation

parts.note: RT is a written abbreviation for right
to relieve pain is to ease it
soreness is pain

explanation.surface: Sportsmen rub on a balm to soothe their aches before a match.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Players' are actors, not sportsmen; 'coming in' puts the relief inside the abbreviation for right, all after the start of the game.
explanation.definitionFit: Greasepaint is theatrical makeup that actors apply before a performance.

clue.text: A figure of speech satisfied a figure in speech

parts.note: to have met a need is to have satisfied it

indicators.note: in speech says the word is said aloud and spelt differently

parts.note: four is a figure, a number

explanation.surface: A rhetorical device apparently fulfils a number mentioned in conversation.
explanation.walkthrough: The number four said aloud gives PHOR.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the classic figure of speech, describing one thing in terms of another.

clue.text: Develop a taste for polish?

definitions.meaning: to start to like someone or something
read literally, to give something a shine, to buff it

explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means to grow fond of; read word by word it means to apply a gloss to something.

clue.text: Group's representative is extremely sullen, keeping mum in support of radiating member

indicators.note: in a down entry, a piece in support of another sits beneath it

parts.note: a spoke is a rod radiating from a wheel's hub

indicators.note: keeping means holding, so the outer letters hold the next piece between them
extremely points to the extreme letters of the word, its first and last

parts.note: ma is a word for mother, mum

explanation.surface: A sulky delegate, protecting his mother, backs a wheel-spoke.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in support of' places the radiating member above the rest, since in a down light the supporting part sits below.
explanation.definitionFit: A spokesman speaks on behalf of a group, acting as its representative.

clue.text: Sect members contributing to sombre threnody

indicators.note: contributing to says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Members of a religious group add their voices to a gloomy lament.
explanation.walkthrough: A threnody is a song of mourning.
explanation.definitionFit: Members of some religious sects, such as the Plymouth Brethren, call one another brothers.

clue.text: Reasonable to quit here, going around Circle Line westward?

indicators.note: going around means surrounding, so the next pieces go inside

parts.note: sane means sensible or reasonable

indicators.note: in an across light westward is right to left, so the letters run backwards

parts.note: O is a circle by its shape
being square, or all square, means being quits with someone

explanation.surface: Someone sensibly decides to get off at a stop on the Circle Line heading west.
explanation.walkthrough: 'westward' turns circle and line backwards before 'going around' wraps them. The station is in west London on the Circle Line, hence 'here'.
explanation.definitionFit: The clue points at a London Underground station, and 'here' stands for that place on the Circle Line.

clue.text: Danish composer finding diarist's otherwise engaged

indicators.note: engaged here means taken on inside, so the diarist holds the other word

parts.note: Anais Nin was a famous diarist; the 's means has
else means otherwise

explanation.surface: A Danish musician turns out to be busy elsewhere, according to the diarist.
explanation.walkthrough: 'otherwise engaged' looks like a set phrase meaning busy; split it, and 'engaged' takes the first word inside the diarist.
explanation.definitionFit: Carl Nielsen was the leading Danish composer, known for his six symphonies.

clue.text: Rattle on sub-machine gun not finishing a gangster

parts.note: to yak is to chatter or rattle on

indicators.note: not finishing means the last letter is dropped

parts.note: the Uzi is an Israeli sub-machine gun

explanation.surface: A gangster chatters away, his sub-machine gun failing to finish someone off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not finishing' drops the last letter of UZI.
explanation.definitionFit: The yakuza are Japanese organised criminals, so a member is a gangster.

clue.text: What lets you hear communications from western lawman that is Anglican

parts.note: Wyatt Earp was a famous lawman of the Wild West
i.e. is the abbreviation for id est, that is
CE stands for Church of England, the Anglican church

explanation.surface: A device for listening to messages from a cowboy sheriff turns out to be churchy.
explanation.definitionFit: An earpiece is a small speaker held to or in the ear for hearing calls or messages.

clue.text: Etna's insides become black, containing cold lava etc

indicators.note: the inner letters of the word are replaced by what follows

parts.note: Etna is the Sicilian volcano; the 's links it to what follows

indicators.note: containing says the black word holds the next letter

parts.note: jet is a deep black
C is the abbreviation for cold, as on taps

explanation.surface: The core of the volcano turns dark, holding cooling lava and other debris.
explanation.walkthrough: Etna's inside letters T and N are replaced by JECT, which is JET with 'containing' putting C inside.
explanation.definitionFit: Ejecta is the material thrown out by a volcano, such as lava, ash and rock.

clue.text: Last part of poem's finale, useless when finales are forgotten

indicators.note: the final letter of each of the two words is left off

parts.note: a finale is the end
void means having no effect, useless

explanation.surface: A poem's closing stanza is pointless once its endings are dropped.
explanation.walkthrough: 'when finales are forgotten' drops the last D of END and of VOID.
explanation.definitionFit: An envoi is a short closing stanza that sends off a poem, especially a ballade.

clue.text: Not getting into gear?

parts.note: it reads as failing to engage a car's gears, but gear here means clothes, so it is refusing to dress

explanation.surface: A motorist is failing to shift into the right gear.
explanation.definitionFit: Nudism is the practice of going without clothing, which is slang gear.

clue.text: Enjoys entertaining one's heroes

indicators.note: entertaining means hosting, so the first word holds the next inside

parts.note: to savour something is to enjoy it
I is the Roman numeral one; the 's means is

explanation.surface: Someone takes pleasure in hosting their idols.
explanation.walkthrough: 'one's' reads as a possessive but is one plus a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A saviour rescues others, and rescuers are hailed as heroes.

clue.text: Following this bird will reveal hunted ones

definitions.text: Following this bird will reveal hunted ones

parts.words: Following this bird will reveal hunted ones
parts.note: F, the abbreviation for following, put in front of this bird makes the word for game birds that are shot

explanation.surface: Tracking a certain bird leads you to its prey.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests stalking a predator to its quarry; actually F placed before the bird gives birds that are hunted.
explanation.definitionFit: The bird is a nocturnal raptor, and F before it spells the word for poultry or game birds.

clue.text: How a musketeer begins to shoot

indicators.note: the musketeer's name begins this way, so only its opening is used

parts.note: D'Artagnan is the musketeer hero of Dumas's novel

explanation.surface: A question of how a swordsman opens fire.
explanation.walkthrough: 'How a musketeer begins' is the opening of D'Artagnan's name.
explanation.definitionFit: To dart is to shoot or dash forward suddenly.

clue.text: Broadcast on TV and online, like Gandhi?

indicators.note: broadcast means scattered widely, so the letters are scattered and rearranged

explanation.surface: A campaign shown on television and the internet celebrates a pacifist.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Broadcast' rearranges ON TV and ONLINE.
explanation.definitionFit: Gandhi led India's independence movement through passive resistance, never through force.
